meta.title: Root Canal Treatment | The British Dental Hub
meta.description: Comfortable, precisely planned root canal treatment for front and back teeth alike, using magnifying loupes and modern rotary instruments in Cairo.

hero.subtitle: Root canal treatment is planned to be as gentle and pain-free as possible, and is available for any tooth that needs it — front or back.

approach.title: Our Approach to Root Canal Treatment
approach.subtitle: Every step is planned with precision equipment and a considered, comfort-focused technique.

loupes.title: Magnifying Dental Loupes
loupes.description: Magnifying dental loupes support finer control and a more precise view throughout every stage of treatment.

rotaryInstruments.title: Modern Rotary Instruments
rotaryInstruments.description: Rotary instruments help shape and clean the root canal system efficiently, supporting a precise, well-controlled result.

singleVisit.title: Single-Visit Potential
singleVisit.description: Depending on clinical assessment, some cases can be completed in a single visit for a more convenient experience.

comfortFocused.title: Comfort-Focused Care
comfortFocused.description: We use considered equipment and materials throughout, aiming for treatment that's as comfortable and pain-free as possible.

everyTooth.title: Every Tooth, Front or Back
everyTooth.description: Root canal treatment is available for any tooth that needs it, front or back, without exception.

whenRecommended.title: When Root Canal Treatment May Be Recommended
whenRecommended.subtitle: These general signs are shared for awareness only — a proper diagnosis always requires a clinical examination with your dentist.

persistentPain.title: Persistent Tooth Pain
persistentPain.description: Ongoing discomfort in or around a tooth is often the first sign worth discussing with your dentist.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity to Hot or Cold
sensitivity.description: Sharp sensitivity that lingers after hot or cold food and drink can be a useful early signal.

swelling.title: Swelling or Tenderness
swelling.description: Swelling, tenderness, or a visible bump near a tooth is always worth a proper clinical assessment.

whenRecommended.footnote: If any of this sounds familiar, the next step is simply a consultation — not a diagnosis. Our team will assess your specific case in person before recommending any treatment.

testimonials.title: What Patients Remember
testimonials.subtitle: Beyond the final result, we believe patients should remember the clarity, calm, and consideration of the experience itself.

item1.quote: I was nervous beforehand, but everything was explained clearly and the treatment itself was far more comfortable than I expected.

item2.quote: The team took the time to explain each step, and the whole appointment felt calm and well organised.

item3.quote: What stood out was how gently and carefully everything was handled, even though I was dreading the visit.

consultationCta.title: Ready to Feel Comfortable Again?
consultationCta.description: Every root canal treatment begins with a comprehensive consultation. We'll assess your tooth, explain the recommended approach, and answer every question before any treatment begins.
consultationCta.noPressure: No pressure. Just honest clinical advice.
consultationCta.contactNote: Our team will personally contact you to arrange your consultation at a convenient time.
